We perform experimental evaluation on two public 3D point clouds datasets \textbf{S3DIS} [[CITE_217]] and \textbf{ScanNet} [[CITE_218]].
S3DIS is composed of 271 point clouds from Matterport scanners in six different areas from three buildings. 
The annotation for the point clouds has 12 semantic classes in addition to one background class annotated with clutter.
ScanNet is made up of 1,513 point clouds of scans from 707 unique indoor scenes. 
The annotation for the point clouds has 20 semantic classes in addition to one background class annotated with unannotated space.
Since the original scene is too large to process, we need to split it into smaller blocks.
As a result, S3DIS and ScanNet contain 7,547 and 36,350 blocks through data pre-processing strategy utilized in [[CITE_219]], respectively. [[MATH_220]] points are randomly sampled for each block and each point is represented by a 9D vector (XYZ, RGB and normalized spatial coordinates).

src: Zero-shot learning~[[CITE_30]] aims to classify images of unseen categories with no training samples via utilizing semantic descriptors as auxiliary information. There are two main paradigms: classifier-based methods and instance-based methods. Classifier-based methods aim to learn a good projection between visual and semantic spaces~[[CITE_31]] or transfer the relationships obtained in semantic space to visual feature space~[[CITE_32]]. Another main branch is instance-based methods~[[CITE_33]] that synthesize some fake samples for unseen classes. The proposed semantic projection network bridges semantic prototypes and visual prototypes, and combines zero-shot learning with few-shot learning to flexibly handle cases with masks and without masks, which greatly eases the heavy demand for large-scale 3D datasets.

content: 信息筛不是一个生成式概率模型。我们以最大化所保留的（多元）信息的方式，构造作为数据函数的潜在因子。尽管如此，由于剩余信息的构造方式，我们可以反向运行该筛子，并且如果我们丢弃剩余信息而只保留 [[MATH_245]]，我们就会得到一种有损压缩。我们可以利用这种有损压缩的解释来执行通常使用生成模型完成的任务，包括图像修复和生成新样本（相反的情况，即将生成模型解释为有损压缩，也已被考虑过~[[CITE_246]]）。
src: The information sieve is not a generative probabilistic model. We construct latent factors that are functions of the data in a way that maximizes the (multivariate) information that is preserved. Nevertheless, because of the way the remainder information is constructed, we can run the sieve in reverse and, if we throw away the remainder information and keep only the [[MATH_245]]'s, we get a lossy compression. We can use this lossy compression interpretation to perform tasks that are usually achieved using generative models including in-painting and generating new examples (the converse, interpreting a generative model as lossy compression, has also been considered~[[CITE_246]]).

最后，尽管以往的方法~[[CITE_16]]以及上述提出的方法通过元学习减少了所需标注样本的数量，但仍然需要逐点的分割掩码。在某些实际应用场景中，我们可能只有感兴趣的类别名称，而没有相应的图像或掩码。
因此，在本工作中，我们提出更进一步，摒弃支撑掩码，[[MACRO_17]]，联合考虑少样本和零样本的3D点云分割，如图~[[REF_18]]所示。为此，我们引入语义信息，[[MACRO_19]]，即类别名称的单词，来指示目标类别，并提出一个语义投影网络（Semantic Projection Network），以桥接语义特征与视觉特征。我们的投影网络以语义嵌入作为输入，输出投影后的原型，并由来自点云的真实原型进行监督。
在测试阶段，除了通过带有密集标注支撑掩码的支撑分支获取原型之外，还可以通过将我们提出的投影网络作用于语义单词来替代地获得原型。

Finally, although previous approaches~[[CITE_16]] and the above-proposed method reduce the number of required annotated samples via meta-learning, point-wise segmentation masks are still necessary. In some practical application scenarios, we may only have the category name of interest but have no corresponding images or masks.
Thus, in this work, we propose to step forward further and discard support masks, [[MACRO_17]], jointly considering few-shot and zero-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, as shown in Fig.~[[REF_18]]. To this end, we introduce the semantic information, [[MACRO_19]], words of category name, to indicate the target categories and propose a Semantic Projection Network that bridges the semantic and visual features. Our projection network takes the semantic embedding as input and outputs a projected prototype, supervised by real prototypes from point clouds. 
During testing, besides obtaining prototypes via support branch with dense-annotated support masks, prototypes can be alternatively obtained by inputting semantic words with our proposed projection network.

content: 零样本学习~[[CITE_30]]旨在利用语义描述符作为辅助信息，对没有训练样本的未见类别图像进行分类。主要有两种范式：基于分类器的方法和基于实例的方法。基于分类器的方法旨在学习视觉空间与语义空间之间的良好映射~[[CITE_31]]，或将语义空间中获得的关系迁移到视觉特征空间~[[CITE_32]]。另一主要分支是基于实例的方法~[[CITE_33]]，该类方法为未见类别合成一些伪样本。本文提出的语义投影网络在语义原型与视觉原型之间建立桥梁，并将零样本学习与少样本学习相结合，从而灵活处理有掩码和无掩码的情形，极大地缓解了对大规模3D数据集的巨大需求。
src: Zero-shot learning~[[CITE_30]] aims to classify images of unseen categories with no training samples via utilizing semantic descriptors as auxiliary information. There are two main paradigms: classifier-based methods and instance-based methods. Classifier-based methods aim to learn a good projection between visual and semantic spaces~[[CITE_31]] or transfer the relationships obtained in semantic space to visual feature space~[[CITE_32]]. Another main branch is instance-based methods~[[CITE_33]] that synthesize some fake samples for unseen classes. The proposed semantic projection network bridges semantic prototypes and visual prototypes, and combines zero-shot learning with few-shot learning to flexibly handle cases with masks and without masks, which greatly eases the heavy demand for large-scale 3D datasets.

这一优异结果表明，transformer具备调整样本间特征通道相关性的能力，这在点云场景中尤为重要，尤其是对于仅有少量训练样本的小样本学习而言。

We conduct detailed component ablation studies to evaluate each of our proposed modules in \tablename~[[REF_289]]. The experiments are conducted on both S3DIS and ScanNet under 2-way 1-shot and 2-way 5-shot settings. We adopt ProtoNet~[[CITE_290]] as our baseline. 
First of all, when adding the proposed Query-Guided Prototype Adaption (QGPA) module on our baseline, a performance gain of 3.97\% and 10.66\% in terms of mIoU under 1-shot settings is observed over the baseline on S3DIS and ScanNet, respectively, as shown in \tablename~[[REF_291]]. The performance gain is because of the benefit of our effective transformer design and the adaption of prototypes from support feature space to query feature space.
The superior result demonstrates that the capacity of transformer in adapting feature channel-wise correlations between samples, which is important in point cloud scenery, especially for few-shot learning with only a handful of training samples.

In some practical application scenarios, we may only have the category name of interest but have no corresponding images or masks.
Thus, in this work, we propose to step forward further and discard support masks, [[MACRO_17]], jointly considering few-shot and zero-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, as shown in Fig.~[[REF_18]]. To this end, we introduce the semantic information, [[MACRO_19]], words of category name, to indicate the target categories and propose a Semantic Projection Network that bridges the semantic and visual features. Our projection network takes the semantic embedding as input and outputs a projected prototype, supervised by real prototypes from point clouds. 
During testing, besides obtaining prototypes via support branch with dense-annotated support masks, prototypes can be alternatively obtained by inputting semantic words with our proposed projection network.

src: Zero-shot learning~[[CITE_30]] aims to classify images of unseen categories with no training samples via utilizing semantic descriptors as auxiliary information. There are two main paradigms: classifier-based methods and instance-based methods. Classifier-based methods aim to learn a good projection between visual and semantic spaces~[[CITE_31]] or transfer the relationships obtained in semantic space to visual feature space~[[CITE_32]]. Another main branch is instance-based methods~[[CITE_33]] that synthesize some fake samples for unseen classes. The proposed semantic projection network bridges semantic prototypes and visual prototypes, and combines zero-shot learning with few-shot learning to flexibly handle cases with masks and without masks, which greatly eases the heavy demand for large-scale 3D datasets.

We perform experimental evaluation on two public 3D point clouds datasets \textbf{S3DIS} [[CITE_217]] and \textbf{ScanNet} [[CITE_218]].
S3DIS is composed of 271 point clouds from Matterport scanners in six different areas from three buildings. 
The annotation for the point clouds has 12 semantic classes in addition to one background class annotated with clutter.
ScanNet is made up of 1,513 point clouds of scans from 707 unique indoor scenes. 
The annotation for the point clouds has 20 semantic classes in addition to one background class annotated with unannotated space.
Since the original scene is too large to process, we need to split it into smaller blocks.
As a result, S3DIS and ScanNet contain 7,547 and 36,350 blocks through data pre-processing strategy utilized in [[CITE_219]], respectively. [[MATH_220]] points are randomly sampled for each block and each point is represented by a 9D vector (XYZ, RGB and normalized spatial coordinates).

我们在 \tablename~[[REF_289]] 中进行了详细的组件消融研究，以评估我们提出的各个模块。实验在 S3DIS 和 ScanNet 上、2-way 1-shot 和 2-way 5-shot 设置下进行。我们采用 ProtoNet~[[CITE_290]] 作为基线。
首先，当在基线上加入所提出的查询引导原型自适应（Query-Guided Prototype Adaption, QGPA）模块时，如 \tablename~[[REF_291]] 所示，在 1-shot 设置下，S3DIS 和 ScanNet 上的 mIoU 分别较基线提升了 3.97\% 和 10.66\%。这一性能提升得益于我们有效的 transformer 设计，以及原型从支持特征空间到查询特征空间的自适应。
优异的结果表明，transformer 具备调整样本间特征通道相关性的能力，这在点云场景中至关重要，尤其是对于仅有少量训练样本的少样本学习而言。
src:
We conduct detailed component ablation studies to evaluate each of our proposed modules in \tablename~[[REF_289]]. The experiments are conducted on both S3DIS and ScanNet under 2-way 1-shot and 2-way 5-shot settings. We adopt ProtoNet~[[CITE_290]] as our baseline. 
First of all, when adding the proposed Query-Guided Prototype Adaption (QGPA) module on our baseline, a performance gain of 3.97\% and 10.66\% in terms of mIoU under 1-shot settings is observed over the baseline on S3DIS and ScanNet, respectively, as shown in \tablename~[[REF_291]]. src: Zero-shot learning~[[CITE_30]] aims to classify images of unseen categories with no training samples via utilizing semantic descriptors as auxiliary information. The proposed semantic projection network bridges semantic prototypes and visual prototypes, and combines zero-shot learning with few-shot learning to flexibly handle cases with masks and without masks, which greatly eases the heavy demand for large-scale 3D datasets.

content: 信息筛（information sieve）并非一个生成式概率模型。我们构造的隐因子是数据的函数，其构造方式使得所保留的（多变量）信息最大化。尽管如此，由于剩余信息的构造方式，我们可以反向运行该筛子；如果丢弃剩余信息而仅保留 [[MATH_245]]，我们便得到一种有损压缩。我们可以利用这种有损压缩的解释来完成通常借助生成模型实现的任务，包括图像修复（in-painting）和生成新样本（反过来，将生成模型解释为有损压缩也已被研究过~[[CITE_246]]）。
src: The information sieve is not a generative probabilistic model. We construct latent factors that are functions of the data in a way that maximizes the (multivariate) information that is preserved. Nevertheless, because of the way the remainder information is constructed, we can run the sieve in reverse and, if we throw away the remainder information and keep only the [[MATH_245]]'s, we get a lossy compression. We can use this lossy compression interpretation to perform tasks that are usually achieved using generative models including in-painting and generating new examples (the converse, interpreting a generative model as lossy compression, has also been considered~[[CITE_246]]).

最后，尽管先前的方法~[[CITE_16]]和上述提出的方法通过元学习减少了所需标注样本的数量，但逐点分割掩码仍然是必不可少的。在某些实际应用场景中，我们可能只有感兴趣的类别名称，而没有相应的图像或掩码。
因此，在这项工作中，我们提出进一步向前迈进并舍弃支持掩码，[[MACRO_17]]，联合考虑少样本和零样本3D点云分割，如图~[[REF_18]]所示。为此，我们引入语义信息，[[MACRO_19]]，类别名称的单词，以指示目标类别，并提出一个语义投影网络来桥接语义和视觉特征。我们的投影网络以语义嵌入作为输入并输出投影原型，由点云的真实原型进行监督。
在测试期间，除了通过带有密集标注支持掩码的支持分支获取原型外，还可以通过使用我们提出的投影网络输入语义单词来获取原型。

Finally, although previous approaches~[[CITE_16]] and the above-proposed method reduce the number of required annotated samples via meta-learning, point-wise segmentation masks are still necessary. In some practical application scenarios, we may only have the category name of interest but have no corresponding images or masks.
Thus, in this work, we propose to step forward further and discard support masks, [[MACRO_17]], jointly considering few-shot and zero-shot 3D point cloud segmentation, as shown in Fig.~[[REF_18]]. To this end, we introduce the semantic information, [[MACRO_19]], words of category name, to indicate the target categories and propose a Semantic Projection Network that bridges the semantic and visual features. Our projection network takes the semantic embedding as input and outputs a projected prototype, supervised by real prototypes from point clouds. 
During testing, besides obtaining prototypes via support branch with dense-annotated support masks, prototypes can be alternatively obtained by inputting semantic words with our proposed projection network.

content: 零样本学习~[[CITE_30]]旨在利用语义描述符作为辅助信息，对没有训练样本的未见类别图像进行分类。主要有两种范式：基于分类器的方法和基于实例的方法。基于分类器的方法旨在学习视觉空间和语义空间之间的良好投影~[[CITE_31]]，或将语义空间中获得的关系转移到视觉特征空间~[[CITE_32]]。另一个主要分支是基于实例的方法~[[CITE_33]]，该方法为未见类合成一些虚假样本。所提出的语义投影网络连接了语义原型和视觉原型，并将零样本学习与小样本学习相结合，以灵活处理有掩码和无掩码的情况，这极大地缓解了对大规模3D数据集的巨大需求。
src: Zero-shot learning~[[CITE_30]] aims to classify images of unseen categories with no training samples via utilizing semantic descriptors as auxiliary information. There are two main paradigms: classifier-based methods and instance-based methods. Classifier-based methods aim to learn a good projection between visual and semantic spaces~[[CITE_31]] or transfer the relationships obtained in semantic space to visual feature space~[[CITE_32]]. Another main branch is instance-based methods~[[CITE_33]] that synthesize some fake samples for unseen classes. The proposed semantic projection network bridges semantic prototypes and visual prototypes, and combines zero-shot learning with few-shot learning to flexibly handle cases with masks and without masks, which greatly eases the heavy demand for large-scale 3D datasets.
